note: Alberta Parks provincial park on Moonshine Lake, 27 km W of Spirit River on Hwy 49, then 7 km N on Hwy 725. Three power loops: A on the north-east shore (a lakeshore trail runs between it and the water), B and C further back; Loop A alone stays open into October. Beach, pier, fish cleaning station and boat launch; blue-green algae advisory posted August 2026. --Claude
